C0881.title: Dongtai Auto Dealership Employees Sentenced for Altering Documents to Divert Incentive Rebates
C0881.summary: Starting in April 2018, sales staff Ding and Xu at an automobile sales company in Dongtai, Jiangsu, privately modified the company's insurance rebate policy documents after receiving them, changing the payout method to direct funds into their personal bank accounts.
